svg.title: Entity Relationship Diagram — DBCAS (14/14)
svg.desc: Bảng quan hệ: mọi khóa ngoại với hướng, cột và cardinality
svg.text: PK = primary key · FK = foreign key · NULL = nullable · legacy/retired tables are shaded amber.

g.text: Foreign keys (120) — source → destination, cardinality, ON DELETE/UPDATE
review_request_requested_by_fkey: review_request(requested_by) → account(account_id) [1:0..N] ON DELETE/UPDATE NO ACTION/NO ACTION
g.title: FOREIGN KEY (requested_by) REFERENCES account(account_id)
